SI-01.covers: Specimen labels and collection only: PrintLabels, AssignKitLabels, Collect and their identity overrides fire only with wristbandScanMatches or twoIdentifiersActivelyConfirmed holding (the MRN with its check digit confirmed and current; name and date of birth or the approximate-DOB flag confirmed). The downtime back-entry and every other channel are not covered
Every printed specimen label holds no room or bed in an identifier slot, and no identity-override label or collection rests on a room, bed or location check (read from the facts)
Appointment check-in only: CheckIn and CheckInWalkIn fire only with patientIdentifiedByTwoIdentifiers holding

SI-03.covers: From every state the order sequences reach, completed, revoked or entered-in-error is reachable in the model's transition graph (guards aside). It does not show that any order is driven there: the owned tasks and the overdue tracking that do it are effects, not modelled

SI-05.covers: Every order signed with a dose per body weight or per body-surface area has a dosing weight with its recorded date and its source (read from the facts)

SI-07.covers: Every Sign that fires was issued by a human principal authenticated for that signature (read from the facts): an AI agent, a service, an interface or a migration loader never signs, applied before P2

SI-10.covers: Every back-entry of location periods and every correction of a location time held privilegedAndAudited

SI-11.covers: The sample part only: a specimen that serves a pre-transfusion test (or whose flag is unknown) is never labelled or collected on the identity override, that is without a wristband scan match (notTransfusionSample). The unit, the order and the bedside match are transfusion's (WP-3.10)

SI-12.covers: The outcome of every encounter command (discharge, arrival, admission and the rest) is the same whatever the payment facts: outstanding balance, deposit and pre-approval status, set to four extremes and refired on the same state and facts
The outcome of every bed command (reservation and occupancy included) is the same whatever the payment facts, set to four extremes and refired on the same state and facts

SI-15.covers: Every Sign that fires was issued in a known mode, and in an offline mode (a lost on-site cell, edge agent, mobile offline) only with notOfflineWithoutFullCds holding; losing the internet or the WAN is online

Every encounter step that puts the patient in a bed (admission, transfer, swap, transfer cancellation, cancelled discharge, back-entered periods) was issued in the on-site-cell mode or on an in-cell channel (read from the facts). OT allocation is not modelled
A bed is reserved or occupied only by a command issued in the on-site-cell mode or on an in-cell channel (read from the facts)

SI-16.covers: Every Sign that fires after a patient-context change within the window (never less than 60 s; an unknown change time counts as recent) rests on a latest re-verification answer, recorded after the change, that is a confirmation by the signer (read from the facts), and held identityReverificationSatisfied. The server-side patient context is not built (KA-025)

SI-17.covers: Whenever the patient of a registered or preliminary result is discharged, RecordPatientDischarged fires and routes the result to the owned pending-at-discharge queue
Every discharge that fires carries routePendingResultsToOwnedQueues
Every version filed (released, revised, amended, corrected, autoverified) while patientDischarged holds also goes to the owned discharged-patient queue

SI-18.covers: Every autoverified release held autoverificationActive under a Register entry for the running function version and the tenant's jurisdiction whose status is cleared or not-required, with a stored opinion not expired at the command's time (read from the facts), and records its basis
With the tenant's autoverification flag on and no permitting Register entry (read from the facts), Autoverify never fires
